title: l1qw.16.1: Python SlotClaim adopts COSE_Sign1 wire format (spec payload keys 1-7, gateway_count off-wire)
description: Child of l1qw.16 (GCP-6.5). python/src/lichen/gateway/slot_claim.py currently serializes a raw CBOR map with gateway_count and string keys (superframe_id/timestamp); spec requires a COSE_Sign1 envelope: protected bstr-wrapped {1:-65537} (reuse lichen.crypto.delegation_tokens.cose_protected_header/cose_sig_structure — proven in l1qw.26.2.1), unprotected {4: gateway 8-byte IID}, payload CBOR map with integer keys 1-7 (slots array, superframe_epoch, mode 0/1, expiry uint, gateway_iid bstr(8), claim_seq, ordinal), 48-byte Schnorr48 signature over SHA256(CBOR(Sig_structure)). gateway_count becomes a local/config parameter only (needed by compute_contiguous_slots) — NEVER on the wire. Update test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim.json vectors (coordinate with the two-tier corpus contract — both suites count them). Keep decode-time strictness (trailing bytes rejected). Sibling .16.2 mirrors in Rust; .16.3 fixes silent-discard.
